mathematical_review: All coefficients/exponents are fixed real constants; c > 0.
Slope D > 0 and D >= 4 C4/c is fixed before L0, L, and s.
L0 >= 2 and exp(max(K,1)) <= D log L ensure all allowed scales have positive bases.
S and T = max(S, exp(max(K,1))) give one L0 = max(2, exp(T/D)) for every later size and scale.
The 3c/4 budget is strictly below c since c > 0 and s >= 1.
Width corollary is conditional on the displayed analytic upper bound; physical reset and entropy/geometry/induction obligations remain separate.
No tensor diagram is required for this scalar analytic argument.

visual_review.method: Rasterize final PDF at 120 dpi and inspect all five PNG pages locally with view_image.
